name: @kweli-mcp/workos-m2m
description: WorkOS client_credentials (M2M) auth, both sides: verify.ts for agents (bulk-place-agent, single-place-agent) checking an inbound token, mint.ts for callers (the Kweli MCP, or any other Nyuchi/Mukoko app) minting an outbound one. Each agent has its own dedicated M2M application (distinct client_id/secret) — a caller's org check is optional per agent (bulk-place-agent enforces one, single-place-agent doesn't).
